import os,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal')
sha='70458fc1b44102b440d2d4c335b5e54f5279f25c'
old='0a1a4c190a7d33752d6dc3f4418ed44735c8a7dd'
stage=root/'.staging'/sha
dest=root/'releases'/sha
current=root/'current'
names=['ssh','nginx','postgresql@16-main','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pm2-iptvpn-bot','pm2-telegram-robot-leads']
def service_states():
 return {x:subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active','--quiet',x],timeout=8).returncode==0 for x in names}
report={'task':'promote-approved-Ferrari-candidate-without-activation','expected_sha':sha,'stage_exists_before':stage.is_dir(),'release_exists_before':dest.exists() or dest.is_symlink(),'active_before':str(current.resolve(strict=True)),'services_before':service_states(),'status':'BLOCKED'}
try:
 assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink()
 assert current.is_symlink() and current.resolve(strict=True)==root/'releases'/old
 assert stage.is_dir() and not stage.is_symlink() and (stage/'.git').is_dir()
 assert not dest.exists() and not dest.is_symlink()
 assert (root/'releases').is_dir() and not (root/'releases').is_symlink()
 assert all(report['services_before'].values())
 call=['git','-c','safe.directory='+str(stage),'-C',str(stage),'rev-parse','HEAD']
 v=subprocess.run(call,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=18)
 assert v.returncode==0 and v.stdout.strip()==sha
 status=subprocess.run(['git','-c','safe.directory='+str(stage),'-C',str(stage),'status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
 assert status.returncode==0 and not status.stdout.strip()
 assert (stage/'engine/skill_job.py').is_file() and (stage/'install/vps-apktool-isolated.sh').is_file()
 report['git_sha_verified']=True
 report['candidate_owner_uid']=stage.stat().st_uid
 assert stage.stat().st_uid!=0 and stage.stat().st_uid==root.stat().st_uid
 os.rename(stage,dest)
 report['move_completed']=dest.is_dir() and not dest.is_symlink() and not stage.exists()
 assert report['move_completed']
 check=subprocess.run(['git','-c','safe.directory='+str(dest),'-C',str(dest),'rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=18)
 assert check.returncode==0 and check.stdout.strip()==sha
 report['release_git_sha_after']=check.stdout.strip()
 report['status']='PASS_RELEASE_PREPARED_NOT_ACTIVATED'
except Exception as exc:
 report['failure']=type(exc).__name__+' '+str(exc)[:100]
 if dest.is_dir() and not dest.is_symlink() and not stage.exists() and current.resolve(strict=True)!=dest:
  try:os.rename(dest,stage);report['rollback_to_stage']=True
  except OSError:report['rollback_to_stage']=False
report['active_after']=str(current.resolve(strict=True))
report['services_after']=service_states()
report['ready_for_separate_cutover']=report['status']=='PASS_RELEASE_PREPARED_NOT_ACTIVATED' and report['active_before']==report['active_after'] and report['services_before']==report['services_after']
print(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True))
if not report['ready_for_separate_cutover']:raise SystemExit(4)
